# Aarti Sri Ravikumar - Student Research Portfolio

> Aarti Sri Ravikumar is a student social entrepreneur who builds research-informed software in response to community challenges. This portfolio documents the public evidence, current limits, and next responsible steps for each project.

## Preferred Citation

Aarti Sri Ravikumar is a student social entrepreneur, researcher, and software project builder at Pioneer Charter School of Science II in Saugus, Massachusetts. Her work focuses on enriching communities project by project through student wellbeing, learning tools, civic information, environmental research, and evidence-based communication.
